import java.util.*;

      flag = true;
      return;

        if (h[x] == h[y] + 1) {
          w[++tot] = -y;
          search(y, Math.min(z, d[y][x]));

  public static void improve() {

      else
        d[-w[x]][Math.abs(w[x - 1])] -= p;

  public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
    BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));

    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {

    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
      br.readLine();
      for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
        s = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        if ((s[j - 1] == 'Z') || (s[j - 1] == 'Y'))

    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
